mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 150k signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a weakening demand environment, which triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 750k and RSAFS < 390k in same month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 97.5 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals economic slowdown and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 97.5 periods (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a rising unemployment rate signals a weakening consumer base, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines > 1.5% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI inflation rate above 3.0% per annum, sustained over three consecutive months, triggers expectations of future monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during high-inflation periods (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 8.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS declines > 50k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized, observed over two consecutive quarters, signals a weakening economy, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1.0% annualized for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during GDP contraction periods (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
